rendererParity: frontend/src is verified byte-for-byte against the pinned reference in CI
referenceSourceParity: source is verified byte-for-byte against the pinned reference in CI
hostAdapter: Fabushi Electron host maps reference Agent tools and inference transport onto the installed Mac
pluginMarketplace: executable by default; MCP/OAuth/private-skill install/publish/listener seams covered
validation: byte-exact renderer/source parity + reference source typecheck + runtime-contract CI + exact-head unsigned macOS prerelease; final interaction test is manual
desktopBridge: official renderer claims classified and covered by runtime tests
coordinatorBridge: official renderer RPC closure + subscription families + exact TrayManager path
sharing: exact Sand cross-user sharing relay adapter bundled; uses Fabushi account bearer token when backend is configured; no backend fails closed
telemetry: reference telemetry retained locally without cloud export
finalValidationPolicy: the final product/CI commit, source gate, macOS package and prerelease tag must resolve to one exact SHA; after that release is verified, a docs-only closeout commit may advance the branch only under projects/grok-bot-018-parity/** without changing desktop/**, .github/**, or pinned reference source
agentInference: Fabushi signed-in account access token is the production bearer credential when FABUSHI_ACCOUNT_INFERENCE_URL is configured; API-key env is fallback only
trayRuntime: pinned Grok TrayManager with async coordinator failures surfaced to local UI
externalEvidence: pinned reconstruction Host activation requires immutable carrier src/app/dist/host/host-main.cjs, which is not stored in the Git repository
releasePolicy: macOS prerelease creation uses the branch ref only after verifying the remote branch still equals github.sha; the workflow then verifies the published lightweight tag resolves exactly to github.sha. Runner-side tag pushes are intentionally avoided because the GitHub App lacks workflows permission.
teachRecording: real local Mac screen recording service; save attaches recording to the Agent and invokes the Learn from demonstration private skill/workflow through the reference Agent runtime
finalCandidateNote: Final release workflow is fail-closed for branch movement and tag mismatch; source gate and macOS package are expected on the same non-empty desktop commit.
projectCloseoutPolicy: post-release evidence synchronization is allowed only as a docs-only project-record commit; release code SHA remains the canonical shipped candidate
dependencyLock: desktop/package-lock.json is synchronized to desktop/package.json for 2.0.0-alpha.3
dependencyInstallMode: npm ci in source-check and macOS package gates
packagedSmokePolicy: headless renderer smoke is diagnostic-only; background Electron is always bounded and force-terminated on step exit; manual installed-product acceptance remains authoritative
packagedSmokeCleanup: EXIT/INT/TERM trap with bounded SIGTERM then SIGKILL
